items.description:
高级Go开发工程师 AI 效能工程师 ai工作流工程师 

AI 工作流工程师

岗位级别：高级 / 资深
技术栈：React / TypeScript + Go
业务方向：在线视频 · 交友 · 出海社交

📌 岗位职责
1. 负责在线视频、交友类产品的全栈架构设计与核心功能开发，覆盖 H5 / PC / WebView 多端及服务端。
2. 参与用户体系、视频播放、互动聊天、动态广场、关系链、推荐匹配、会员权益、支付结算等核心业务模块建设。
3. 基于 React 进行组件化开发，使用 Go 进行高并发服务端开发，持续提升系统的可扩展性与稳定性。
4. 参与工程化建设，覆盖构建优化、CI/CD、监控埋点、服务治理、限流降级等。
5. 推进 AI 能力在全栈场景的应用落地，覆盖文本（对话/翻译/文案）、图像（生成/修图）、音频（TTS/语音识别）、视频（特效/理解/审核）等多模态方向。
6. 参与 AI 工作流与 Agent 编排能力的工程化建设，包括流程配置、多模型串联、工具调用（Function Calling）等。
7. 构建 AI 服务的稳定性保障体系，包括输出校验、安全过滤、成本控制、语义缓存、异常熔断与降级，将不稳定的模型输出转化为可靠可控的业务接口。

🎯 任职要求

1. 本科及以上学历，5 年以上开发经验。
2. 前端能力：熟练掌握 React 及 TypeScript，具备大型项目开发经验。
3. 后端能力：熟练掌握 Go 语言，有微服务或高并发系统经验（同时具备 PHP 经验者优先）。
4. 熟悉 MySQL、Redis、消息队列等中间件，具备数据库建模与性能优化能力。
5. 熟悉 Linux 环境，具备线上问题定位、服务部署与故障处理能力。
6. 熟悉高并发、高可用架构设计，对限流、熔断、降级、灰度发布等有深入理解。
7. 熟悉移动端 H5 开发，能处理适配、兼容、弱网、缓存等常见问题。
8. AI 工程化：熟悉大模型 API 调用与调优，有文本/图像/音频/视频等至少一类多模态 AI 能力的实际集成经验；了解 Embedding、向量检索、RAG、AI Agent 等工作流相关技术。
9. AI 稳定性：能够通过工程手段（格式校验、语义缓存、降级熔断、成本监控等）将不稳定的 AI 输出转化为稳定可靠的业务接口。
10. 具备较强的技术探索意愿和产品意识，能在 AI 技术快速迭代的环境中主动跟进并推动落地。

⭐ 加分项

1. 有在线视频、直播、社交、交友、IM、音视频互动类产品经验。
2. 熟悉视频播放器、HLS、WebRTC、弹幕、连麦等相关技术。
3. 有跨端框架（React Native / Flutter）开发经验。
4. 有大模型、RAG、AI Agent、智能客服或 AI 社交产品落地经验。
5. 有 AI 多模态服务（图像生成/理解、TTS、视频处理等）落地经验。
6. 有 AI 输出质量评估、幻觉检测、安全过滤方案落地经验。
7. 有团队技术负责人或核心模块 Owner 经验。

✨ 岗位亮点

• 核心业务：千万级海外用户的视频社交产品，场景丰富。
• AI 前沿：覆盖文本/图像/音频/视频全模态，涉及大模型工程化、向量检索、Agent 编排。
• 全栈视野：从前端交互到服务端架构，完整技术链路掌控。
• 成长空间：高级/资深岗位，技术决策空间大，鼓励创新与实验。
• 国际化：全球化团队协作，开放的技术氛围。
==

Go 高级开发工程师
岗位职责：
- 负责公司核心业务模块的设计与开发，编写高质量、高可维护性的 Go 代码
- 参与高并发服务的设计与实现，保障系统在高流量场景下的稳定性与性能
- 负责服务接口设计与开发，确保 API 的兼容性、安全性与高效性
- 进行数据库设计与优化，编写高性能 SQL，处理复杂业务场景下的数据一致性问题
- 参与技术方案评审，进行 Code Review，推动团队代码质量与工程效率提升
- 配合运维团队完成服务的容器化部署、监控告警配置及线上问题排查
    

任职要求：
- 计算机相关专业本科及以上学历，4 年以上后端开发经验，2 年以上 Go 语言实战经验
- 精通 Go 语言特性，深入理解 goroutine 调度、channel 通信、内存管理及 GC 原理
- 熟练掌握至少一种 Go Web 框架（Gin/Echo/Go-zero 等），具备丰富的 RESTful/GRPC API 开发经验
- 熟悉 MySQL/MongoDB，具备索引优化、慢查询分析、事务处理及分库分表实践经验
- 熟练使用 Redis，掌握缓存设计模式，能够处理缓存穿透、击穿、雪崩等问题
- 熟悉消息队列（Kafka/RocketMQ/RabbitMQ）的使用场景与最佳实践
- 具备高并发系统开发经验，掌握常见的并发设计模式与性能调优手段（pprof、trace 等）
- 熟悉 Docker、Kubernetes 等容器化技术，了解 CI/CD 流程与 DevOps 实践
- 具备良好的系统设计与抽象能力，能独立完成模块级技术方案设计与落地
==

更多职位看 频道 ，谢谢！！！
==
公司：FineStar 是一家全球化信息技术企业，总部设于英国伦敦，在中国台北、日本东京、新加坡、吉隆坡、台湾、洛杉矶等设立分支机构，全球员工规模超 1500 人。 我们是主流媒体、视频平台、线上社区论坛的一站式综合服务商。公司不止交付标准化产品，更输出创新、差异化的运营思路，助力客户实现业务高速增长与品牌升级转型。依托深厚的行业技术积淀，我们持续打磨创新方案，打造超出预期的落地成果，面向全球客户提供高品质服务体验与完整 IT 解决方案。 公司核心管理团队深耕 Web 业务及多赛道产品运营，行业经验丰富；同时组建了一支高素质的数据、创意与技术研发人才队伍。
薪资以及其他说明：薪资发u，远程，不实名，不压工资。每日工作9小时左右。工资准时发。单休，法定正常放假，春节12天，年假12天。

关键考核指标：产量、一次通过率、合格镜头率、单位算力产出。；

3、具备较强的提示词（Prompt）编写能力，能精准表达画面需求，高效产出符合要求的素材；
4、配合团队完成内容创意与成片交付，保障产出效率与质量。
二、任职要求
1、熟练使用剪映等剪辑工具，能独立完成视频剪辑；
2、有相关剪辑或视频作品，提供30秒以内的成片样片；
3、会使用AI进行生图，人物细节表现力好；
4、提示词使用能力较好，能够通过文字精准控制生成效果；
5、责任心强、自驱力好，具备良好的沟通协作能力，适应远程办公节奏。

加分项：
1、有AI视频生成（图生视频/文生视频）相关经验；
2、熟悉多款剪辑或AI工具，具备一定审美与创意能力。
备注：需要会剪辑有作品即可推荐
==
AI短剧编剧 15-30k 远程办公
一、岗位介绍
1、负责成熟题材、情感向 AI 短剧的选题策划、热点分析、剧本创作与内容开发。
2、需要具备专业的编剧能力和敏锐的网络热点捕捉能力，能够从社会热点、情感事件。
3、本岗位接受成熟题材、海外泛娱乐内容创作方向。
二、岗位职责
1、负责成熟题材 AI 短剧的选题策划、故事构思和剧本创作。
2、持续关注网络热点、社会话题、情感事件及短视频平台趋势，保持强网感，敏锐捕捉热点与爆点，挖掘适合短剧开发的高热度素材。
3、对热点内容进行二次创作，完成原创化、戏剧化和系列化改编，擅长将话题爆点转化为剧情爽点、泪点和反转点。
4、负责故事梗概、人物小传、人物关系、世界观设定及分集大纲的设计。独立完成短剧剧本、分集剧本、场景描述、人物对白等内容。
应聘时需提供个人相关作品（剧本、短剧、分镜表、短视频脚本或作品集）。
加分项
1、有成熟题材短剧、情感向影视、AI 漫剧等剧本创作经验有短剧爆款、网络小说、短视频脚本或高传播内容作品。
2、熟悉 Seedance 2、LibTV、无限画布等 AI 内容创作工具。具备 AI 编剧、提示词撰写或 AI 视频生产流程经验。
3、熟悉短剧平台、短视频平台及网络热点传播规律，网感突出，有爆款选题或热点借势案例。有成熟的题材库、人物库或连续剧开发经验。
4可提供分镜表、分镜脚本、已上线作品或完整剧本案例者可以快速安排面试

备注： 有编辑经验即可推荐

items.title: 57 company profiles missing company_size or required sections
items.description:
These 57 company profiles fail `.github/scripts/validate-companies.js` because they're missing something only a person can fill in. Until they're fixed, **anyone who opens a PR touching one of these files gets a failing validation check** for problems they didn't cause.

(Invalid tech tags and slug/filename mismatches are being fixed separately in #2294 and #2293.)

## How to help

Pick one or a few, check the company's own website, and open a PR. Please keep each PR to a handful of profiles so they're easy to review.

- **`company_size`**: add one of `tiny` (1–10 employees), `small` (11–50), `medium` (51–200), `large` (201–1000) or `enterprise` (1000+). The company's About page or LinkedIn usually says.
- **Missing sections**: add the heading listed (`## Company blurb`, `## Remote status` or `## How to apply`) with a short, factual paragraph. For `Remote status`, describe the company's actual remote policy as the company states it, not a guess.
- If the company has **closed or been acquired**, say so in a comment here instead of filling it in, and we'll remove the profile (see #2271 for an example).

See [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/remoteintech/remote-jobs/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full format. You can check your work locally with `node .github/scripts/validate-companies.js src/companies/<file>.md`.

items.description:
### Nossa empresa

Sobre a BotCity

A BotCity está construindo o futuro da automação com sua Plataforma de Governança para automações em Python e Agentes de IA. Ajudamos empresas a inovar em escala, levando governança, controle e observabilidade a cada projeto de automação. Nossa filosofia é simples: automação é software, e software merece os mesmos padrões high-code que impulsionam a inovação em IA e machine learning.

Recentemente, captamos uma rodada Série A de US$ 12 milhões, liderada pela Four Rivers e com participação da Y Combinator, da SoftBank e de grandes nomes do mercado, como Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source) e Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). Com mais de 1.000 clientes em mais de 70 países, entre eles Bayer e LG, e reconhecida pela G2 (2024) como uma das 25 principais plataformas emergentes do mundo, a BotCity está crescendo rápido.

Somos uma empresa global e remota, com times nos EUA e na América Latina, unidos pela visão de redefinir como as empresas criam e gerenciam suas automações. Se você busca um ambiente que valoriza impacto, autonomia e excelência, adoraríamos ter você com a gente nessa jornada.

### Descrição da vaga

**Sobre o Programa Trainee 2027**

O Programa Trainee 2027 da BotCity foi desenhado para formar futuros talentos. Mais do que olhar para um currículo pronto, estamos buscando pessoas com potencial, capacidade de aprendizado e vontade de colocar a mão na massa.

Você tem paixão por tecnologia, curiosidade metódica e quer acelerar o início da sua carreira em uma empresa que desenvolve soluções globais?

**O que oferecemos na sua Trilha de Formação (6 meses)**

Imersão & Cultura:Treinamento profundo na plataforma BotCity, nossas ferramentas e rotinas.
Visão de Negócio: Imersão no ciclo do cliente, participando de rotinas técnicas e entendendo dores de mercado.
Evolução Prática: Atuação gradual no suporte técnico aos clientes, diagnóstico de problemas e criação de documentação.
Acompanhamento Próximo: Mentoria com a liderança, acompanhamento de um Buddy da área e check-ins mensais com o time de People.
Desafio Final: Oportunidade de estruturar e apresentar um projeto real de melhoria para a área.

**Em qual área vai atuar**

Automation Experience com possibilidade de aprofundar nas demais áreas da BotCity. 

**Etapas**

Inscrição: 20/Outubro até 13/Novembro
Testes Online
Live Case
Entrevistas (Técnica e Comportamental).
Proposta
Início do Programa: Janeiro/2027

### Local

Hibrido com fácil acesso a Campinas/SP

### Requisitos

**O que buscamos**

Cursando último ano da graduação ou concluída há no máximo 2 anos em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Analise de Sistemas ou áreas afins (formação entre 2025 e 2026).
Conhecimento com programação.
Curiosidade por automação, tecnologia e resolução de problemas.
Inglês fluente.
Aprende rápido, tem iniciativa e assume suas entregas.
Se comunica com clareza e gosta de ajudar clientes.
Curte trabalhar em equipe, mas também consegue se organizar sozinho(a) no remoto.
Mora em Campinas e região.

**Vai brilhar ainda mais se tiver**
Habilidade em Python.
Projetos com automação, scripts ou dados, seja na faculdade, num estágio ou por conta própria.
Experiência com atendimento ou suporte ao cliente.
Alguma familiaridade com Git, APIs ou ferramentas como Jira.

## Location

* District 7, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
* Full-time position

## Salary Expectation

* Up to 50,000,000 VND gross per month

## About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to join an international product team.

You will lead and mentor a team of 4–5 engineers, take ownership of technical direction, and collaborate with international Engineering and Product stakeholders.

Strong Senior Ruby on Rails Engineers who are ready to step up into a Lead role are also welcome.

* 5+ years of professional software development experience

* Strong understanding of Ruby, Rails conventions, and engineering best practices
* Experience with system design, architecture, REST APIs, and relational databases
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or SQL Server

* Designing and evolving scalable Ruby on Rails systems
* Improving application performance and production reliability
* Defining modular and reusable system architecture
* Developing and maintaining APIs and database solutions
* Strengthening CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and incident management practices
* Balancing technical quality with product and business outcomes

A Protege Cash é uma instituição de pagamento em fase de crescimento, e estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora fullstack para atuar de ponta a ponta nos canais digitais: o Internet Banking web em React e o aplicativo mobile em React Native, além do backend em Java.

Um dos principais desafios da posição é levar para o app as mesmas funcionalidades e regras construídas no Internet Banking web, com a mesma qualidade e as mesmas boas práticas nas duas frentes. **Desejáveis:**
- Node.js/NestJS
- Kubernetes/Helm
- Experiência com meios de pagamento, internet banking ou app bancário
- Integrações com core bancário (ex.: Autbank, Matera)

**Diferenciais:**
- Uso de assistentes de IA no desenvolvimento

## Contratação

PJ nos primeiros 6 meses, depois efetivação em CLT pela Protege Cash.

A Protege Cash é uma instituição de pagamento que oferece Internet Banking e aplicativo mobile, em fase de crescimento e com portfólio em evolução constante.

**Thông tin vị trí**
Cấp bậc: Senior
Địa điểm: Quận Tân Bình TP. Hồ Chí Minh
Thời gian làm việc: Thứ Hai – Thứ Sáu, 08:30 – 17:30
—-------------------------------------------------------
**MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC** 
- Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế hệ thống và phát triển các tính năng cho hệ thống Tài chính/Cho vay (Finance/Lending).
- Phát triển ứng dụng backend bằng Java và frontend bằng Angular, đảm bảo sự tích hợp liền mạch giữa các thành phần của hệ thống.
- Thiết kế, phát triển và tối ưu hóa RESTful API; triển khai logic nghiệp vụ và tích hợp với các hệ thống liên quan.
- Làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu Oracle/MS SQL Server, bao gồm viết truy vấn SQL, tối ưu hóa truy vấn và xử lý dữ liệu.
- Phối hợp với Business Analyst (BA), đội ngũ Đảm bảo chất lượng (QA) và các bên liên quan để hỗ trợ triển khai, kiểm thử và xử lý sự cố.

**YÊU CẦU BẮT BUỘC** 
**_Kỹ năng và kinh nghiệm chuyên môn_** 
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học/ Cao đẳng chuyên ngành IT
- Có 5+ năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm.
- Thành thạo phát triển backend bằng Java; ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm với Spring Boot, Spring Framework và Spring Security.
- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển frontend bằng Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS và tích hợp API.
- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế, phát triển RESTful API, triển khai cơ chế xác thực và phân quyền (Authentication/Authorization), cũng như tích hợp hệ thống.
- Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với Oracle hoặc MS SQL Server, bao gồm viết câu lệnh SQL, thủ tục lưu trữ (Stored Procedures) và tối ưu hóa truy vấn.
- Có khả năng phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp kỹ thuật, thực hiện Code Review và chủ động giải quyết các vấn đề kỹ thuật độc lập.
**_Kiến thức về lĩnh vực Tài chính_** 
- Có kinh nghiệm tham gia các dự án thuộc lĩnh vực Tài chính/Ngân hàng.
- Hiểu biết về các quy trình nghiệp vụ tài chính cơ bản và xử lý dữ liệu giao dịch.
- Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật và yêu cầu nghiệp vụ bằng tiếng Anh.

==========================================
Ứng tuyển ngay hoặc inbox em để trao đổi thêm về cơ hội nhé:
💌 Email: linh.tran@dikshatek.vn
📞 Phone/Zalo: 0817 377 143 (Ms. Linh)

items.title: GALAXY JOY - Data Engineer - 2 headcounts
items.description:
# 🚀 Hiring: Data Engineer | GalaxyJoy 

📍 **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam  
🏢 **Department:** Technology  
👤 **Reporting to:** Senior Data Engineer  
💼 **Experience:** From 4 years

## About GalaxyJoy

GalaxyJoy is a member of the Galaxy Holdings Digital Ecosystem, working to build innovative loyalty solutions that connect customers, partners, and services through technology and data.

We are looking for a **Data Engineer II** to build reliable data pipelines, integrate diverse data sources, and optimize our cloud data platform to power analytics and data-driven decision-making.

## What You'll Do

- Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from S3, SFTP, SharePoint, email, and APIs.
- Develop and operate **Apache Airflow** workflows with reliable monitoring and failure alerting.
- Design and optimize data schemas, tables, and transformations in **Snowflake**.
- Manage data infrastructure using **Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi/Terraform)**.
- Integrate external data sources end-to-end, from ingestion and mapping to transformation and validation.
- Implement data quality checks to detect schema drift, missing data, and pipeline failures.
- Optimize pipeline and query performance as data volumes grow.
- Collaborate with Data Analysts, Backend Engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

## What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 2–4 years of experience in Data Engineering or a related role.
- Strong **SQL** skills and proficiency in **Python, TypeScript**, or a similar language.
- Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses such as **Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift**.
- Experience with **Apache Airflow** or equivalent workflow orchestration tools.
- Familiarity with **AWS (S3, IAM)** and cloud data architectures.
- Experience handling structured and semi-structured data (**CSV, JSON, Parquet**).
- Solid understanding of data modeling, incremental loading, and pipeline design patterns.
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and ownership skills.

### Nice to Have
- Experience with **Pulumi, Terraform, or AWS CDK**.
- Experience integrating external data through SFTP, APIs, or file-based feeds.
- Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, and pull request reviews.

## 🎁 What We Offer

- Competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
- 100% of the official salary during probation.
- Comprehensive health and accident insurance.
- 15 days of annual leave per year.
- Work equipment provided: MacBook/laptop, monitor, mouse, and more.
- A modern, creative, and collaborative working environment.

## 📩 Apply Now

Ready to build reliable data pipelines and turn data into value?
Send your CV to **[talent@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:talent@galaxyjoy.vn)** or **[truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn)**.
**Subject:** Application – Data Engineer II – [Your Name]

items.title: GALAXY JOY - Middle/Senior Quality Control Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing) - 4 headcounts
items.description:
**Mission**
The QC Engineer is responsible for driving product quality and testing maturity across the team by owning end-to-end test strategies, building scalable automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile platforms, and mentoring junior engineers.

This role serves as a technical reference point and quality leader, ensuring that every release meets high standards of reliability, stability, and user trust. The QC Engineer works closely with Developers, BA, Product Owners, and DevOps to identify quality risks early, optimize test coverage, and continuously improve QA processes for fast and confident product delivery.

**I. Key Responsibilities**
- Define and own comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test approaches for complex features and cross-platform initiatives, applying risk-based analysis to prioritize scope and optimize coverage.
- Design and execute complex test scenarios across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and UAT testing for web, API, and mobile (Flutter) applications.
- Design, build, and maintain mobile automation frameworks for Flutter applications, covering cross-device and cross-OS scenarios (iOS & Android).
- Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for Web UI and API testing using Playwright, Postman/Newman, or equivalent, including reusable components, utilities, and libraries.
- Lead API testing strategy across microservices and distributed systems, including authentication, schema validation, contract testing, and third-party integrations.
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and optimize execution time through parallelization and stable test design.
- Drive defect triage, root-cause analysis, and impact assessment for production issues, and contribute to release readiness assessments and Go/No-Go decisions.
- Mentor and coach junior/middle QC engineers through code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pair testing.
- Act as a quality advocate in cross-functional discussions with Dev, BA, PO, and stakeholders, and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
- Champion adoption of ATDD/BDD/TDD practices and shift-left testing approaches; identify gaps in QA processes and implement scalable improvements.
- Support basic performance/load testing execution using tools such as K6, JMeter, or Locust when required.

**II. Requirements:**
- 3+ years of professional experience as a QC / Software Test Engineer, with proven track record of delivering quality across web, API, and mobile platforms in Agile/Scrum environments.
- Strong hands-on experience in manual testing, with deep expertise in test case design techniques (equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, exploratory testing) and the ability to translate complex business requirements into comprehensive test scenarios.
- Strong hands-on experience with mobile automation testing, ideally for Flutter applications
- Solid understanding of mobile testing fundamentals: device fragmentation, OS versioning, gestures, push notifications, deep linking, offline behavior, and app lifecycle.
- Proven experience designing and building automation frameworks from scratch (not just maintaining existing ones), with strong knowledge of design patterns such as Page Object Model, Factory, Dependency Injection, and Data-Driven Testing.
- Proficient in modern API automation frameworks (Playwright API, Cypress API, Postman/Newman, RestAssured) and Web UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium WebDriver).
- Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred), Dart, Python, or Java.
- Extensive hands-on experience with API testing (Postman, Swagger, RESTful APIs, GraphQL), including authentication, error handling, schema validation, and contract testing across microservices and distributed systems.
- Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and proficient with Git and code review practices.
- Strong SQL skills for data validation, debugging, and root-cause analysis; comfortable analyzing application logs and backend behavior.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, strong communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentoring mindset, and ownership mentality.
- Experience testing Flutter applications in production at scale.
- Experience in loyalty, fintech, banking, e-commerce, or e-wallet domains.
- Exposure to performance testing tools: K6, JMeter, Blazemeter, Locust.
- Experience with security testing (OWASP Top 10, JWT, OAuth, SQL injection, XSS).
- ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent certifications.
- Good English communication skills (reading, writing, and speaking).

**III. Benefits:**
- Competitive salary package (Base salary and performance bonuses).
- Probation period salary is 100% of the official salary.
- Comprehensive health and accident insurance.
- 15 days of annual leave.
- Provision of work equipment (Macbook/Laptop, mouse, monitor, etc.).
- A creative and modern working environment.

**_Feel free to contact me if you need any assisstant or send your CV to mail: [talent@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:talent@galaxyjoy.vn)
[truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn)_**
